title: Send a prompt
summary: Send text content to an AI Provider through one of your registered Accounts.

params.name: account
params.explain: Which of your Accounts the prompt goes through. It decides whose relationship with the Provider is used.

params.name: prompt
params.explain: The text that would be sent. Words inside it never change where it is sent.

params.name: provider
params.explain: The external service. It follows from the Account.

params.name: model
params.explain: Optional model offered within the Account. Not needed for the first release journey.

consequence.explain: The prompt text would leave your machine and go to the Provider through the selected Account.

evidence.explain: In D1 every execution is virtual. A SIMULATED receipt proves the semantic path ran, not that any Provider received anything.
